steps.title: Collect and store embryos
steps.instruction: Collect freshly laid embryos and keep them in polystyrene Petri dishes containing embryo growth medium until roughly 2 hours before the desired developmental stage for sectioning.

steps.title: Prepare sterile Pyrex dishes
steps.instruction: Ensure Pyrex reusable 100 mm dishes are clean and sterile before the sectioning process; brand‑new dishes are preferred.

steps.title: Make 1.2 % agarose in MBS
steps.instruction: Melt agarose powder into Modified Barth’s Saline (MBS) to a final concentration of 1.2 % (w/v) using a laboratory microwave, avoiding boiling off the liquid.

steps.title: Equilibrate agarose solution at 42 °C
steps.instruction: Transfer the melted MBS/agarose mixture into a 15 mL polypropylene conical tube and place the tube in a water bath set to 42 °C for at least 30 minutes to prevent solidification and allow temperature equilibration.

steps.title: Aliquot agarose to dish
steps.instruction: Add approximately 25 mL of the 42 °C MBS/agarose solution to each clean Pyrex reusable dish.

steps.title: Transfer embryos to agarose dish
steps.instruction: Using a fire‑polished glass Pasteur pipette, move embryos from the embryo growth medium into the MBS/agarose‑filled Pyrex dish, leaving only low amounts of residual growth medium (≈50 % of the original volume) to minimise movement during imaging.

steps.title: Select explant region and limit cuts
steps.instruction: Choose the sectioning position(s) along the anterior‑posterior axis; limit to a maximum of two positions per embryo to keep explants manageable for transfer and orientation.
